title: Start Storybook
description: Serve up storybook in development mode.

browserTarget.description: Build target to be served in project-name:builder:config format. Should generally target on the builder: '@angular-devkit/build-angular:browser'. Useful for Storybook to use options (styles, assets, ...).

tsConfig.description: The full path for the TypeScript configuration file, relative to the current workspace.

preserveSymlinks.description: Do not use the real path when resolving modules. If true, symlinks are resolved to their real path, if false, symlinks are resolved to their symlinked path.

configDir.description: Directory where to load Storybook configurations from.

https.description: Serve Storybook over HTTPS. Note: You must provide your own certificate information.

sslCa.description: Provide an SSL certificate authority. (Optional with --https, required if using a self-signed certificate).

sslKey.description: SSL key to use for serving HTTPS.

ci.description: CI mode (skip interactive prompts, don't open browser).

open.description: Whether to open Storybook automatically in the browser.

enableProdMode.description: Disable Angular's development mode, which turns off assertions and other checks within the framework.

docs.description: Starts Storybook in documentation mode. Learn more about it : https://storybook.js.org/docs/writing-docs/build-documentation#preview-storybooks-documentation.

compodoc.x-deprecated: Compodoc no longer runs. @storybook/angular-vite extracts Angular metadata in-process, so this option does nothing. Remove it from angular.json.

compodocArgs.x-deprecated: Compodoc no longer runs. @storybook/angular-vite extracts Angular metadata in-process, so this option does nothing. Remove it from angular.json.

styles.description: Global styles to be included in the build.

stylePreprocessorOptions.description: Options to pass to style preprocessors.

includePaths.description: Paths to include. Paths will be resolved to workspace root.

loadPaths.description: Alias for `includePaths` using the dart-sass/Vite spelling. Paths will be resolved to workspace root.

sass.description: Options to pass to the sass preprocessor.

fatalDeprecations.description: A set of deprecations to treat as fatal. If a deprecation warning of any provided type is encountered during compilation, the compiler will error instead. If a Version is provided, then all deprecations that were active in that compiler version will be treated as fatal.

silenceDeprecations.description: A set of active deprecations to ignore. If a deprecation warning of any provided type is encountered during compilation, the compiler will ignore it instead.

futureDeprecations.description: A set of future deprecations to opt into early. Future deprecations passed here will be treated as active by the compiler, emitting warnings as necessary.

initialPath.description: URL path to be appended when visiting Storybook for the first time

previewUrl.description: Disables the default storybook preview and lets you use your own

loglevel.description: Controls level of logging during build. Can be one of: [trace, debug, info (default), warn, error, silent].

logfile.description: If provided, the log output will be written to the specified file path.

followSymlinks.description: Allow glob patterns to follow symlink directories. This allows subdirectories of the symlink to be searched.

input.description: The input directory path in which to apply 'glob'. Defaults to the project root.

ignore.description: An array of globs to ignore.

bundleName.description: The bundle name for this extra entry point.

inject.description: If the bundle will be referenced in the HTML file.
